run_stones_and_potions_test: run the absltest suite that validates index round-trip conversion for all stone and potion types
test_aligned_stone_from_index: test that aligned_stone_from_index and AlignedStone.index convert to and from each other for all valid indices
test_perceived_potion_from_index: test that perceived_potion_from_index and PerceivedPotion.index round-trip correctly across all valid indices
test_partial_potion_map_from_index: test that partial_potion_map_from_index round-trips using axis and direction assignment indices with precomputed maps
test_potion_map_from_index: test that potion_map_from_index and PotionMap.index convert correctly using index_to_perm_index and perm_index_to_index
